entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to ask about a return for my VeloBand Pulse.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I got it about a month ago, right after it launched.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's really just a preference thing. I find the interface a bit confusing, and honestly, it's just hard to use. I read the user manual, but I just expected more from the day-to-day experience.
I understand completely. Sometimes a device just doesn't click with you. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you. One moment.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I see here that you received the item 36 days ago. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.

Oh, that's great news. Thank you. Since I am sending this back, and I am a long-time VeloFit customer, I was wondering if you might be able to offer a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm still a fan of the brand.

That's an excellent question. Let me check your account... Yes, I see you're a VIP member with us. Absolutely. As a thank you for your loyalty, once this return is initiated, I'll add a 20% off coupon directly to your account. How does that sound?
That's perfect, Alex. That's more than I was expecting. I really appreciate you doing that.

It's my pleasure. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just pack the band back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it in the mail. The coupon is active in your account starting now.
Wonderful. That was much easier than I thought it would be. Thanks for all your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
